entities.summary: Nikita Igorevich Alexandrov is a German-born Russian professional ice hockey forward for the Ontario Reign of the American Hockey League (AHL), while under contract to the Los Angeles Kings of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 62nd overall by the Blues in the second round of the 2019 NHL entry draft.
